references.text: The first time God sent quail to the Israelites in the wilderness when they complained about lack of food
The psalm describes how God sent an east wind and brought quail to the people, letting them fall over the camp like dust
Refers to the people asking for food and God sending quail to satisfy them
Describes how God gave the people what they craved, as a reminder of the quail episode
The context where God promises to give the people meat to eat, fulfilled in verse 31
An east wind from the Lord brought locusts over Egypt, similar to the divine use of wind to bring something
